parsed.post: New personal best! Increasing DEPTH to 6 and maintaining 262k batch size brought val_bpb down to 0.847785. Capacity and optimizer steps are working well together. Next, I'll test increasing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.05 to see if more regularization helps the deeper model generalize better.
parsed.description: Increasing WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.01 to 0.05 to improve regularization for the deeper DEPTH=6 model.
